/-- [producer_field47::field::wide_exact::{producer_field47::field::wide_exact::WideExact}::mul]:
    Source: 'field/wide_exact.rs', lines 112:4-126:5
    Visibility: public -/
def field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul
  (self : field.wide_exact.WideExact) (rhs : field.wide_exact.WideExact) :
  Result field.wide_exact.WideExact
  := do
  let ac ← field.QM31.mul self.c0 rhs.c0
  let bd ← field.QM31.mul self.c1 rhs.c1
  let q ← field.QM31.add self.c0 self.c1
  let q1 ← field.QM31.add rhs.c0 rhs.c1
  let cross ← field.QM31.mul q q1
  let q2 ← field.wide_exact.mul_u bd
  let q3 ← field.QM31.add ac q2
  let q4 ← field.QM31.sub cross ac
  let q5 ← field.QM31.sub q4 bd
  ok { c0 := q3, c1 := q5 }

def field.wide_exact.WideExact.to_le_bytes
  (self : field.wide_exact.WideExact) : Result (Array Std.U8 32#usize) := do
  let bytes1 := Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8
  let (s, to_slice_mut_back) ← lift (Array.to_slice_mut bytes1)
  let (cem, chunks_exact_mut_back) ←
    core.slice.Slice.chunks_exact_mut s 4#usize
  let a ← field.wide_exact.WideExact.to_limbs self
  let (iter, zip_back) ←
    core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.zip.trait_default
      (core.slice.iter.ChunksExactMut.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIteratorMutASlice
      Std.U8) (Array.Insts.CoreIterTraitsCollectIntoIteratorTIntoIter Std.U32
      8#usize) cem a
  let back ← field.wide_exact.WideExact.to_le_bytes_loop iter (fun z => z)
  let cem1 := zip_back back
  let s1 := chunks_exact_mut_back cem1
  ok (to_slice_mut_back s1)
